field.label: Enabled
field.help: Uncheck to ignore this device entirely.

field.label: Name
field.help: A name for this device, shown on the dashboard widget.

field.label: Address
field.help: IPv4 address or CIDR, e.g. 192.168.1.50 or 192.168.1.0/24. Give the device a static lease first, or its address will change and the rule will follow the wrong device.

field.label: Mode
field.help: Always allowed, always blocked, or allowed only during the hours below.

field.label: Days
field.help: Days the schedule applies to. On other days the device is blocked.

field.label: Internet allowed from
field.help: 24-hour HH:MM. A window where "from" is later than "to" crosses midnight.

field.label: Override
field.help: Temporarily force the device allowed or blocked, ignoring the schedule. The dashboard widget sets this.

field.label: Description
field.help: Optional note for your own reference.
